description.value: Rose Gardens Park is a publicly maintained rosarium operated by the City of Penticton as part of its parks and gardens network in the South Okanagan. The garden is mapped in OSM as a dedicated rose-style garden, making it a distinctive green-space destination amid the orchard and vineyard landscape of Penticton. Touring cyclists riding through the Okanagan can use it as a scenic rest stop in the heart of the city.
